claims.claim: The paper gives a consistent, asymptotically unbiased estimator for all proper calibration errors and refinement terms, including KL calibration error induced by cross-entropy.
claims.quoted_support: we propose a method that allows consistent, and asymptotically unbiased estimation of all proper calibration errors and refinement terms.

claims.claim: Refinement relates to f-divergences, implying information monotonicity in neural networks irrespective of the proper score optimized.
claims.quoted_support: we prove the relation between refinement and f-divergences, which implies information monotonicity in neural networks, regardless of which proper scoring rule is optimized.

claims.claim: Experiments suggest the choice of post-hoc calibration method should depend on the calibration error of interest (CIFAR-10/100 with PreResNet; isotonic regression vs temperature scaling).
claims.quoted_support: the selection of a post-hoc calibration method should be determined by the particular calibration error of interest.

breadth.confidence_families: not present (searched: language model, LLM, verbal confidence; body has zero LLM hits)
breadth.calibration_metrics: Class-wise calibration errors (KL, Brier-type, L2), ECE as special case of top-label (Section 2; Section 7; Table 3 before/after IR and TS).
